claims.sentence: After evaluation of inflammation, dyslipidemia and oxidative stress biomarkers, subjects with the greatest response to the functional treatment will be selected for additional 6 weeks of functional intervention associated to a reduction of the hypolipidaemic drugs intake, which will be prescribed individually after evaluation of the responsible physician.
